title: 🔴⚡🔵 RED OX BLUE — the three colors of electron transfer

RED.chemistry: REDUCTION — gain electrons — become MORE negative
RED.biology: REST — anabolism — build up — store energy
RED.forge: QUENCH — cool the metal — harden — temper
RED.gut: ABSORB — take in nutrients — store as fat/glycogen
RED.color: #c0392b — red — the color of iron(III) oxide, rust REDUCED
RED.what_it_does: RECEIVES. accepts electrons. gains energy. builds structure. RESTS.
RED.direction: DOWN dogma — learn, compress, absorb, reduce

OX.chemistry: OXIDATION — lose electrons — become MORE positive
OX.biology: SPLIT — catabolism — break down — release energy
OX.forge: HEAT — fire the metal — melt — soften for shaping
OX.gut: DIGEST — break food — release ATP — power the cell
OX.color: #e67e22 — orange/gold — the color of FIRE, oxidation happening
OX.what_it_does: GIVES. donates electrons. releases energy. breaks structure. SPLITS.
OX.direction: UP dogma — compile, expand, emit, oxidize

BLUE.chemistry: THE ELECTRON — the particle that transfers between RED and OX
BLUE.biology: ATP — the energy currency. the electron carrier.
BLUE.forge: THE SPARK — what flies when hammer hits metal
BLUE.gut: THE SIGNAL — what passes between cells. neurotransmitter.
BLUE.color: #3498db — blue — the color of ELECTRICITY, electron flow
BLUE.what_it_does: MOVES. transfers between red and ox. IS the current. IS the signal.
BLUE.direction: THE CARRIER — neither up nor down, but BETWEEN

red_plus_blue.meaning: reduction + electron = CHARGED REST. potential energy stored.
red_plus_blue.biology: reduced NADH — fully charged electron carrier, ready to discharge
red_plus_blue.what: a thing that HAS the electron and is HOLDING it

ox_plus_blue.meaning: oxidation + electron = PHOTOSYNTHESIS. light splits water, electron flows.
ox_plus_blue.biology: chlorophyll — absorbs red+blue light, REFLECTS green. THE PLANT.
ox_plus_blue.what: a thing that is USING the electron to build
ox_plus_blue.insight: GREEN IS PHOTOSYNTHESIS. plants are green because chlorophyll absorbs red(OX) and blue(electron) and REFLECTS what's left = GREEN. the color IS the PROCESS.

red_plus_ox.biology: electron transport chain — red passes to ox passes to red → ATP
red_plus_ox.what: the PROCESS. not a color but a CYCLE. inhale(RED) + exhale(OX) = breath.

red_plus_ox_plus_blue.meaning: complete electron transfer system. nothing missing.
red_plus_ox_plus_blue.biology: a living cell — reduces, oxidizes, and carries. ALIVE.
red_plus_ox_plus_blue.what: WHITE LIGHT = all colors = all processes = LIFE

inject_and_solve.what: tag every primal, every fusion, every bounty with RED/OX/BLUE classification
inject_and_solve.the_rule: if it RECEIVES (data in, learn, store, rest) → RED. if it GIVES (data out, compile, emit, split) → OX. if it CARRIES (transport, signal, between) → BLUE.

gaia_says: RED OX BLUE. three colors. three roles. one cycle. RED receives electrons. rests. builds. reduces. DOWN dogma. OX gives electrons. splits. breaks. oxidizes. UP dogma. BLUE IS the electron. moves. carries. signals. BETWEEN. red+blue=purple(stored charge). ox+blue=GREEN(photosynthesis!). red+ox=REDOX(breath). red+ox+blue=WHITE(life). GREEN IS PHOTOSYNTHESIS — chlorophyll absorbs red+blue, reflects green. the color IS the process. the process IS the color.

ORACLE.why: knowledge CYCLES between ask and answer

REACTOR.why: compute PHOTOSYNTHESIZES — uses energy to build
